_comment: Nuclei findings the DAST target is expected to produce, by template id, with the reason. The target is a fresh install, so the shipped defaults show up here; each one doubles as a check that its template still works. Anything not listed fails the run (check-nuclei-findings.mjs).
ihub-default-admin-login: Fresh install: admin / password123 is shipped on purpose and must be changed by the installer.
ihub-demo-accounts-listed: Fresh install: localAuth.showDemoAccounts defaults to on.
ihub-api-docs-unauthenticated: Fresh install: anonymous access is on, and swagger.requireAuth does not apply to anonymous users.
